description: This file defines configuration settings for push notification build parameters, including transport mode, distribution mode, APNs environment, and relay URL. It includes enums, a struct, static methods for reading configuration from info dictionary, and logic for determining relay usage.

classes.name: PushBuildConfig
classes.description: Structure that encapsulates the configuration parameters needed for push notification build setup, including transport mode, distribution mode, optional relay URL, and APNs environment. Provides initialization from a bundle and utility methods for reading config values.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer that reads configuration values from the provided bundle, with default fallbacks.

methods.name: usesRelay
methods.description: Computed property that returns true if the transport mode is relay.

methods.name: readURL
methods.description: Static helper method that reads and validates a URL string from the bundle, ensuring it's an HTTPS URL with no user info, password, query, or fragment.

methods.name: readEnum
methods.description: Generic static helper method that reads a string value from the info dictionary and converts it to an enum case with the specified raw value, applying trimming and case normalization.
